scripts.book:build: npm run book:meta:release && vuepress build docs && node scripts/build-book.mjs && node scripts/build-epub.mjs && node scripts/verify-epub.mjs
scripts.book:release: npm run book:build && npm run book:kpf && npm run book:kpf:verify
scripts.docs:build: npm run book:meta && vuepress build docs
scripts.docs:clean-dev: npm run book:meta && vuepress dev docs --clean-cache --port 6060
scripts.docs:dev: npm run book:meta && vuepress dev docs --port 6060
scripts.dev: npm run book:meta && vuepress dev docs --clean-cache --port 6060
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run book:build && npm run book:verify && git diff --check
